quri.access_evidence: Pinned README requires PostgreSQL and Anthropic and/or OpenRouter API keys for evaluation; end-to-end/LLM tests require provider calls. CI-safe tests do not constitute matched document evaluation.

arms.limit: FAR-COG audits supplied coding; it does not automatically extract semantic verdicts from arbitrary documents. Score abstention and coding labor, not fictitious decisive coverage.
Freeze actual exported profile, prompt bytes, model version and budget before execution; generic internal lexical control is not this arm.
Needs authorized model/provider/version and equal resources; no model agreement as independent truth.
Authenticated configuration and scope match required; vendor benchmarks do not supply this arm's results.

matched_input_requirements: Freeze identical raw document and evidence bytes before predictions; no label leakage.
Record separately any operator-supplied semantic coding and labor; do not give one arm hidden oracle annotations.
Use the same interpretation/time/source-eligibility constraints, not just matching topic names.
Register new exploratory cases separately from EFR and the frozen #518 benchmark.
Use a separate, disclosed adjudication process before any effectiveness claim; independent/human execution remains deferred.
exit_condition: Every arm has actual replayable output under a frozen configuration and scoped adjudication, or an explicit unavailable/NOT_EXECUTED result; no advantage or disadvantage inferred from absent access.
